name: morphogen-v2
description: Morphogen v2 — CPU Gray–Scott + Canvas 2D (GPU contexts forbidden)

scripts.check:nowebgl: rg -n -i "webgl|webgpu|getContext\(['\"]webgl" src && exit 1 || echo 'OK: no GPU canvas context APIs in src'
scripts.test: esbuild tdClient=src/sync/tdClient.ts syncUrl=src/sync/syncUrl.ts panels=src/ui/panels.ts grayScott=src/sim/grayScott.ts hum=src/audio/hum.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test tests/
